review_scope: Current uncommitted benchmark implementation and targeted test fixtures

verified_controls.detail: Only CloudError with status 423 and code admission_closed enters recovery; original transport failures, 500, OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, stale_epoch, and other errors preserve the original attempt.
At most four sends and three fresh recovery demands; a shared admission deadline bounds entry into later attempts and the recovery/FIFO wait.
tool_op_id, kind, command, and timeout_ms remain fixed across definite-refusal retries. The next send reads the latest execution epoch.
logical_request_id, payload, and terminal_turn stay fixed across retries. Per-attempt cache query, submitted_at, and execution_epoch update separately in the evidence row.
RUNNING or OUTCOME_UNKNOWN tool receipts end the current benchmark operation without another send. Existing core requests and tool receipts are deduplicated by original ID and business hash.

After acquiring a FairSlots token, refresh runs under return_pending=True. A completed automatic return is observed with the current epoch before constructing another demand; acquired token ownership is retained.
The initial epoch remains the comparison anchor. An epoch increase by one requires MEMORY and records a resume; a same-epoch OPEN gate records admission_reopened.
All recovery FIFO waits add to gateway_queue_seconds; admission_recovery_seconds records recovery elapsed time. Tool resource intervals contain accepted tool executions.

before_request captures the latest cache query without closing the previous cohort. request_accepted closes it once after successful registration. Definite admission refusals retain the previous exposure cohort.

fixture_scope.gate_fields: Resume fixtures contain the explicit RUNNING/OPEN or QUIESCING/CLOSED gate values observed by production code.
epoch_paths: Automatic return completes while waiting for FIFO capacity: epoch 2 to 3, MEMORY, current state accepted.
Quiesce rolls back in the same epoch: gate reopens, admission_reopened recorded, MEMORY resume count unchanged.
identity_and_failure_paths: Same operation and frozen timeout/command after a definite refusal.
Single attempt retained for transport failure, unknown outcome, unexpected code/status, and existing RUNNING/OUTCOME_UNKNOWN receipt.
Four refusal attempts and fresh per-attempt demand identities.
Deadline crossing and recovery failure prevent subsequent submissions.
Model cache query updates at each attempt; successful logical registration emits one model_submit and closes one previous cohort.
